category_doubt.finding: Manufacturer and retailer directions describe a pre-wash SCALP treatment (apply to palms or scalp, massage the scalp, leave >= 10 min, shampoo/rinse). The Oil authority's roles (pre_wash_fibre_treatment, leave_on_fibre_conditioning, dry_finish) are fibre roles; a scalp-only use cannot be mapped to them without inventing fibre support. Claims include hair-growth support/thinning hair (medically adjacent) and actives (menthol, camphor, wild mint oil) with irritation potential.

options.text: Re-categorise to Scalp Care: product_scalp_care_specs {primary_role: density_claim_tonic (claim-led: growth/thinning wording) or scalp_comfort (dry/irritated scalp wording) - needs decision, presentation_format: oil, rinse_mode: rinse_off, application_instructions from the directions} + a scalp_care protocol (pre-wash, rinse_off_scalp_care family). Moves category_key/category and drops the legacy oil eligibility rows. Needs Nick + hair-care-expert on the role and the cosmetic-vs-medical wording (CLAUDE.md: separate cosmetic from medically adjacent hair-loss guidance).
Keep in Oil and add a new scalp-only oil role to the Oil authority (code + contract change). Larger change; only worthwhile if more scalp oils are expected.
Keep unassessable on purpose (no spec), i.e. leave 'Noch nicht einschätzbar' until the category/role decision.

category_doubt.not_proposed: A product_oil_specs row or an oil protocol: would require fibre-role support the sources do not give.

open_questions: Which category/role (A/B/C above)? If B: density_claim_tonic vs scalp_comfort, and how the growth wording is handled.
